name: Seed Trough
description:
One trough for spare seeds, shared by every field farm. Place it once near your fields.

Bots:
• Barley, Carrot, Flax, Green Kale, Hemp, Leek, Lettuce, Millet, Pipeweed, Poppy, Pumpkin, Radish, Turnip, Watermelon and Wheat Farmer (required)
• The Farmer Quality bots (optional, for clearing out low-quality seeds)
• Swill Piles to Troughs

In each area:
• Trough for seeds: a trough
